verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents a telemetry opt-out control. The privacy posture rests on the repo tagline "Private by default. Offline by design," docs saying the local CLI and SDK run offline without an account, and a Hacker News reply asserting "no data is collected." Together these suggest there is little or nothing to opt out of locally, but no first-party telemetry policy confirms it, and hosted Wally Cloud usage is tracked (`wally account usage`) with no documented opt-out. Missing for 10: a first-party telemetry/data-collection policy, a documented opt-out flag or setting, clarity on cloud-side usage tracking, independent verification of the no-collection claim.
